shortDescription: Malaysia's IHH Healthcare MYX:IHH said on Tuesday that an Indian court directed the appointment of a forensic auditor in relation to certain applications filed by Japan's Daiichi Sankyo TSE:4568 against Fortis Healthcare NSE:FORTIS.
